steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Without further ado, let's begin the first joint Zeruertza-Acahualla-Rhodes Island swimming competition!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I'm Croque Diamondface, Zeruertza's business representative. This broadcast is brought to you by Deculture Silvermint's newest high-definition camera.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: First, let's take a look at the course.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The race will take place on an underground lake that stretches from here, all the way to the tunnel.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Here are the rules:

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Anything goes, and whoever gets to the other side of the lake first is the winner!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The winner will get an unlimited supply of my special craft ale for one month!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The Rhodes Island representative is—

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The Wind of Iberia, Rhodes Island's sexiest man, Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What's up, Durins?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Was that introduction why he pulled Croque to the side to talk to her?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The Acahualla representative is—

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Go for it, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey everybody!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: And we have a surprise for the Zeruertza representative—

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Master Edge, our environment and climate representative!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: How did a tunnel survey turn into a swimming competition?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's a rare opportunity, isn't it?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: We're still waiting on the equipment, after all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Plus, it's not easy to go back and forth with the railway out of operation. If we're going over anyway, we might as well do something fun with it.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Sigh... have it your way.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Aren't you coming?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Not interested. I would rather check up on Tomimi and Deculture's progress.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What a boring Ursus woman.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'm not Ursus!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And how did you convince Master Edge?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: I volunteered, Avdotya.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: I just wanted you to help me out while you're having fun.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Now that you've helped me, I certainly won't object to this little event.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We have plenty who like to play in the water, but not a single one who's actually a good swimmer.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: This is about the pride of Zeruertza, after all, so I've got to put this sack of old bones on the line.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't sweat it, Master. It's all friendly competition.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: You say that, but I can't have people talking about how Zeruertza lost to a bunch of surface-dwellers!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Avdotya said she's not interested. She didn't say she wouldn't do it.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Durins aren't a pushy people. If she doesn't want to join, I won't force her.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Plus, Avdotya isn't a native of Zeruertza. Makes sense she wouldn't want to represent us.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Looks like it's up to me then.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...Alright, alright, I'll compete on behalf of the Durins!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Happy now?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: How can I not, after what you said?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's more like it!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Croque!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Are you really going to participate, Avdotya?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Is there a problem?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: (Whisper) Unlimited supply of craft ale for one month. It will be a real hit for me if she wins this.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Well, it's just friendly competition. No need to be too serious about it.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'll win this! For Zeruertza, and for the ale!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Er, alright, good luck.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Excuse the interruption. We have an announcement to make.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Avdotya will be subbing in for Master Edge as the representative of Zeruertza.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Let's give her a round of applause!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You still have to come with us across the river, though, Master Edge.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about you ride on my back during the competition? I'll take you across.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Was that intended to be an insult, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? No.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I just don't think I'll lose.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Speaking of which, you should probably get changed if you're gonna race.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Since you're carrying extra weight, these clothes will do just fine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Just because I don't exercise often doesn't mean I'm out of shape.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'm not so weak that I'll lose to a Sargon.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ha. There it is, that's the face. Haven't seen you make a better one yet.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Dúra.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Contestants, please take your positions.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: They're calling us.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I have ears.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Maybe this isn't the best time to interrupt, but did they forget that I'm competing as well?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whatever. They'll find out who has the real skills when the action starts.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: On your marks.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ready.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hang on tight, Master Edge. Things could get a little rough once the race starts.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Don't underestimate the wisdom of age.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Get—

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Damn it, I got provoked into letting my Ursine slip.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'll beat you, Gavial.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Set—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, come to think of it, I should have asked Croque to add the title 'Lone Ranger' to my name.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll remember for next time.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: It just occurred to me... don't I have to follow them if I want to get a good angle with the camera?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: But I don't have a boat, and I can't exactly hold a camera while swimming. What do I do?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ah well, never mind.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Go!
At Croque's command, the three contestants — plus one passenger — leap into the water.
The race begins.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Gavial has taken the lead.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Ever since she came to Zeruertza, Gavial has wowed us with her superb athleticism.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: She's gotten ahead of the pack, even with Master Edge on her back!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: They're having a little too much fun.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Why don't you join them, Stitch Canvas?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Deculture?! Why are you here? Aren't you working on repairing the railway?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: No problem, I've put the bots to work there.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Keep your distance. I have Oripathy.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Oripathy doesn't spread so easily, does it?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Plus, I like the peace and quiet of your place.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Well, there's a surprise. Gavial is still in the lead, as expected.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: But how many of us would have expected Avdotya to be hot on her tail?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Who could have guessed that the elegant lady of Zeruertza has such power within her?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: She's keeping pace with Gavial, who hasn't been able to shake her.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Oops, I can't see. Can someone give me a shoulder to stand on?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: There we go. Thanks.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I've read in 'Stranger Things' that the people of Ursus are a hardy folk, able to live on nothing but ice for three months. I still didn't expect Avdotya to really keep pace with Gavial...

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: You sure are interested in what's going on there. Why don't you go over and have a look?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Not interested. It's a waste of time.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Really? You've hardly touched your sketch since the race started.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What do you want, Deculture?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I'm just curious, Stitch. What's troubling you?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Because you felt like you deceived Gavial and her friends?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Things don't have to be so complicated. Everything will fall into place if you agree to fix the dome.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: You don't want to fix the dome, so you're using the vote results as an excuse not to do it. Instead, you made the proposal to demolish the slide and repair the railway.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: And I'm not wrong! Blowing up the slide and fixing the railway will allow us to detect the spread of active Originium!

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I didn't say you were wrong. While machine surveying of Originium has fallen out of fashion, the equipment we have is still usable.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Master Edge's problems will be solved once we build a boat and set things up.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: He won't be pestering you about the dome anymore. You can continue your design work in this hut of yours, competing with Catch, and everybody lives happily ever after.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Why are you anxious?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: What are you anxious about?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: We're at the halfway point, 300m point.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: What's that? It's 400m already? Alright.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Anyway, the order hasn't changed since the start of the race, with Gavial in the lead, Avdotya in second place, and Elysium in third.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Al-though Elysium has not overtaken the others, his form is a thing of beauty!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Is he staying in third place on purpose?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I just feel uneasy.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Like I've dumped everything on them.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I agreed to compete with Catch on a design for a new Zeruertzan landmark... but how can I convince the people? I have no confidence there.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: You'll get along so much better with Catch if you're being honest about your feelings with him.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: ...It won't happen.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I'll never like him, and he'll never like me.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Hm... well, I'm just looking for a place to take a break. It's none of my business if you want to keep staring at a blank piece of paper.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: But if you want to check things out—

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Deculture, Deculture. The first boat for the railway project is complete and ready by the lakeside.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: The excavation and survey equipment that Master Edge asked for. You can help me deliver it.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Deculture, Deculture, taking care of Stitch.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I'm not the only one taking care of him.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Well, I can take a nap now that he's gone.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I'll leave the rest to you and the surface-dwellers.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Do not worry. Zumama, our friend, will help. Do not worry.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: You like her that much?

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Zumama cares for us. We like Zumama.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: What a strange surface-dweller.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface Up High
steps.text: We're here by the lake to get a better view!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface Up High
steps.text: Hey, is that Stitch the architect over there?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface Up High
steps.text: Wait, stop fidgeting! I'll lose my footing!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface Up High
steps.text: Whoa!!!
The Durins have made a Durin tower for Croque, so she can see the race better.
It is not easy to keep up a tower consisting of dozens of Durins, however, and it begins to lean at Croque's movement, eventually—

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ouch, my butt...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The robot said the boat is parked around here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: This is the equipment that Master Edge asked for?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'll load Gavial's equipment onto it as well, and ask someone to bring the boat across.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Hff... phew...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: This is the boat?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Stitch? I think so.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Off I go then.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Oh, he just got onto the boat that the robots brought to the lakeside, and he's sailing across the lake!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Did he come to join the competition?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Come to think of it, the rules don't say you can't use vehicles!
